changes.name: SkyboundProgressionRewards
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
local areas={
 {name="Grasslands",folder=map,orb="SkyCoins",reward=1000000},
 {name="Waterfall",folder=map.WaterfallIsles,orb="WaterfallCoins",reward=2000000},
 {name="Desert",folder=map.DesertTemple,orb="DesertCoins",reward=4000000},
 {name="Frozen",folder=map.FrozenPeaks,orb="FrozenCoins",reward=8000000},
 {name="Volcano",folder=map.VolcanoRealm,orb="Orbs",reward=16000000},
 {name="Celestial",folder=map.CelestialCity,orb="Orbs",reward=32000000},
 {name="Void",folder=map.VoidRealm,orb="Orbs",reward=64000000}
}
local busy={}
for _,a in ipairs(areas) do
 local folder=a.folder:FindFirstChild(a.orb)
 if folder then for _,orb in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
  if orb:IsA("BasePart") then orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
   local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent);if not p or busy[orb] then return end
   local c=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not c then return end
   busy[orb]=true;local power=p:GetAttribute("PetPower") or 0;c.Value+=a.reward+(power*math.floor(a.reward*.25))
   orb.Transparency=1;orb.CanTouch=false;local l=orb:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight");if l then l.Enabled=false end
   task.delay(7,function() if orb.Parent then orb.Transparency=0;orb.CanTouch=true;if l then l.Enabled=true end;busy[orb]=nil end end)
  end) end
 end end
end
